title: Integrability of the Radon–Nikodym density
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $f\colon \Omega 	o  br$ be the real-valued Radon–Nikodym density of $\mu$ with respect to $
u$, that is, the function whose value at each point $x$ is the real number obtained from the Radon–Nikodym derivative $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x)$. Then $f$ is integrable with respect to $
u$.
replaced: The function $\mathrm{rnDensity}(\mu,\nu)$ is integrable with respect to $\nu$.
